topic: 日常安排与习惯 · Independent new scenario: a weekly routine with changes and reasons
grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Week 5 Listening: A Busy Week with Changes
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的模拟听力练习，不是官方雅思考试。先听录音（或阅读文字稿），然后完成8道题。题目和选项都是英文，解释是中文。注意：听力中有自然对话和纠正，答案不会直接读出。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Leo. Do you work every day?
Leo: No, I don't. I work Monday to Friday. But this week is different.
Mia: Why?
Leo: My sister visits on Thursday. So I stay home on Thursday.
Mia: Do you go to the gym on Thursday?
Leo: No, I don't. I go to the gym on Tuesday and Friday.
Mia: What time do you start work?
Leo: I start at nine. I finish at five.
Mia: Do you have lunch at home?
Leo: No, I don't. I eat lunch at a café near my office.
Mia: Do you study English in the evening?
Leo: Yes, I do. I study English on Monday and Wednesday. I don't study on Friday.
Mia: OK. See you on Thursday!
Leo: See you!

questions.prompt: When does Leo work in a normal week?
questions.explanation: Leo说“I work Monday to Friday.”，所以正常一周工作周一到周五。

questions.prompt: Why does Leo stay home on Thursday this week?
questions.explanation: Leo说“My sister visits on Thursday. So I stay home on Thursday.”，因此这周周四留在家里是因为姐妹来访。sister本身不区分姐姐或妹妹；健身、学英语是谈话中的其他活动，不是这句话给出的原因。

questions.prompt: Does Leo go to the gym on Thursday?
questions.explanation: Mia问“Do you go to the gym on Thursday?”，Leo回答“No, I don't.”，所以周四不去健身房。

questions.explanation: Leo说“I finish at five.”，所以下班是五点。答案填five。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，实义动词用原形，不加 -s。否定句用 don't + 动词原形。疑问句用 Do + 主语 + 动词原形？回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't. 时间表达如 on Monday, at nine, every day 常与一般现在时连用。频率词如 always, usually, often, sometimes, never 放在动词前。
grammar.example: I work Monday to Friday. I don't study on Friday. Do you work every day?

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，实义动词用原形 study。
主语是 they，否定用 don't + 动词原形。
主语是 you，一般现在时疑问句用 Do 开头。

questions.prompt: I ___ to the gym on Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 go。
questions.evidence: I go to the gym on Tuesday.

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，动词用原形 have。
主语是 they，疑问句用 Do。
主语是 you，动词用原形 start。
主语是 I，实义动词 understand 的否定用 don't。
